# Ultha (ultha.co)

> Ultha Moktan does customer research for founder-led B2B AI startups. AI research gives everyone the same answers; she talks to a startup's customers (won, stalled and lost) and finds the patterns, so founders get a clear direction for sales and marketing: what to focus on, who to target and what to say.

About: Former product manager and co-founder of a marketing agency that worked with 40+ brands. Customer research she ran led to +34% and +17% feature adoption. Based in Santa Barbara, CA. Contact: ultha@ultha.co.

## Services and prices
- Why They Buy sprint, $9,500, 4 weeks (founding rate $5,000 for the first five clients who book by November 25, 2026; start by November 16 for findings before the holidays, or book a January start): 10-15 interviews with won, stalled and lost buyers; findings report and one-page summary; positioning and messaging fix sheet; quote bank; 1-hour decision workshop. About 3 hours of the founder's time.
- Won, Lost, Left, $3,000/month after a sprint: ongoing win-loss and churn interviews, 4 a month, with a one-page memo each month. 3-month minimum.
- Something custom (for example a homepage rewrite or a different mix of calls): scoped on request. https://ultha.co/pricing#custom
- Free homepage review: send a homepage, get a short review video. https://ultha.co/#review

## Who it's for
Founder-led B2B software startups, mostly AI, with real customers (about 40 people who decided in the last six months) and nobody owning customer research yet. Common problems: "everyone said yes and nobody bought", "we sound like every other AI tool", lost deals that give polite excuses, churned customers who don't reply.

## Methods
Customer interviews, win-loss interviews, churn interviews, jobs-to-be-done (switch) questions, voice-of-customer research, building an ideal customer profile (ICP) from best customers. Calls are confidential; quotes are anonymized unless a customer agrees.
